export_evidence: ImportKey India customs records page (https://importkey.com/countries/india/virgo-hydraulic-private-limited) states "Total Shipments 141 Records detected" and "Latest Cargo 2026-02-28"; the visible table shows 5 rows, e.g. "2026-02-28 | VIRGO HYDRAULIC PRIVATE LIMITED | JINDAL STEEL SOHAR LLC | 20042852, OIL SEAL 75 X 95 X 10 MM- SAHAR AIR CARGO ACC INBOM4, India | MUSCAT, OMAN | 40169320 | 1107757" and "2026-02-16 | VIRGO HYDRAULIC PRIVATE LIMITED | PETROCORP COMPANY WLL | O-RING 170 X 3.5 MM - VITON- SAHAR AIR CARGO ACC INBOM4, India | KUWAIT KUWAIT INT, KUWAIT | 40169320 | 9718668". Source counter vs rows seen: page claims 141 shipments / 3 trading partners / 5 ports; only 5 shipment rows were actually rendered on the free view. Destinations observed: Oman (Muscat) and Kuwait; HS 40169320 (gaskets, washers, seals of vulcanised rubber) matches the declared 401693. A second slug (virgo-hydraulic-pvt-ltd) returned an empty record set, so the confirmed data rests on the first slug only.
domestic_evidence: No verifiable domestic-supply record obtained. GST turnover band, GeM/CPPP tender awards and annual-report domestic/export splits were not retrievable: thecompanycheck.com and zaubacorp.com returned HTTP 403, tofler.in returned HTTP 404 for the guessed CIN path, indiamart.com returned HTTP 429, and DuckDuckGo search was unavailable (connection refused) throughout the session. No GSTIN, turnover figure or contract is asserted here because none was read from a primary source.
note: Export side is factually confirmed, not merely declared: dated air-cargo customs entries from Sahar Air Cargo ACC (Mumbai) to Jindal Steel Sohar LLC (Oman) and Petrocorp Company WLL (Kuwait), Feb 2026 and Dec 2025, with bill-of-lading numbers (1107757, 9873950, 9718668, 9477399, 7950518) and HS 40169320. Declared HS 401693 is consistent with the observed shipments; the second declared code 848190 (valve parts) was not observed in the visible rows, which is not a discrepancy requiring correction since only 5 of 141 rows were visible. Domestic supply status is unknown rather than none_found: the absence of evidence here is a tooling/access limitation (403/404/429 blocks and search outage), not a finding that no domestic supplies exist. Revenue and export volume figures are null — not public in the accessible free views and not estimated. No registry or catalogue data was used as shipment evidence.
